title: Economía y dependencia
goal: Read how US corporate control of key industries, single-export vulnerability, and foreign debt created economic dependency, as the 1954 Guatemala coup shows.
grammar: Cuanto más... (tanto) más: relaciones que crecen juntas

items: Explain what Árbenz's Decree 900 agrarian reform did.
Describe which sectors US companies came to control.
Explain the link between single-export economies and vulnerability.
Explain how a country's foreign debt affected its creditors' influence.
Use cuanto más... (tanto) más to link two growing quantities.
